en.description: A real-estate agent's portfolio: current listings on a map, property details and a quick enquiry form.

landing.headline: Find your next home. Talk to the agent who knows the street.
landing.subheadline: Browse my current listings: see each property on the map and send an enquiry in a minute. I answer the same day.

features.title: Every listing on the map
features.description: See where each flat, house or office is before you ask, and compare streets at a glance.

features.title: Details that answer questions
features.description: Size, rooms, price and the highlights that matter, written by the agent who walked through every room.

features.title: One click to enquire
features.description: Ask about a property straight from its card; your message reaches me with the listing attached.

howItWorks.heading: How do you find your property?

steps.title: Browse the listings
steps.description: Filter flats, houses and offices and open the ones you like.

steps.title: Check it on the map
steps.description: See the neighbourhood, the distance to the centre and what is nearby.

steps.title: Ask about it
steps.description: Send an enquiry from the card and I will get back to you the same day.

items.question: Are the prices final?
items.answer: They are the asking prices agreed with the owners. Every offer is open to a conversation about terms.

items.question: Can I visit a property this week?
items.answer: Yes. Send an enquiry from the listing and suggest a time; I confirm viewings by phone or e-mail.

items.question: Do you also help sellers?
items.answer: Yes. I prepare the listing, the photos and the viewings, and keep the owner informed after every visit.

landing.eyebrow: Homes and offices in your city

manifesto.lead: Buying a home starts with the right street, not the right ad.
manifesto.body: I show every property I sell on the map, with the details I would want to know myself, so you can decide what to visit before you spend a Saturday on viewings.

cta.label: Browse listings
cta.title: Ready to see the properties?
cta.subtitle: Sign in to save the listings you like and keep notes on each one.
